snippet.title: Goodbye, GTA 5
snippet.description:

From our first time exploring Los Santos to crazy police chases, heists, funny moments with friends, and causing chaos for absolutely no reason.

GTA 5 has been part of our lives for over a decade. We grew up with this game, made memories we'll never forget, and somehow, after all these years, we kept coming back.

Now, with GTA 6 around the corner, it's finally time to say goodbye to an era.

Thank you, GTA 5, for everything. ❤️

One last ride through Los Santos. 🥹

snippet.title: Goodbye GTA5 🥀
snippet.description:
أكبر ساعة في العالم (مكة المكرمة)

تقع ساعة مكة المكرمة أعلى برج الساعة ضمن مجمع أبراج البيت في مكة المكرمة. يبلغ ارتفاع البرج حوالي 601 مترًا، ويتميز بأربع واجهات ضخمة يمكن رؤيتها من مسافات بعيدة. صممت الساعة بالطراز الإسلامي، وتضم العديد من الخصائص الفريدة، من بينها عبارة «الله أكبر»، إضافة إلى أكبر هلال صنع في العالم

معلومات إضافية عن ساعة مكة:

الارتفاع والوزن

يبلغ ارتفاع برج الساعة 601 مترًا، ويصل الوزن الإجمالي للساعة إلى حوالي 36,000 طن، وفقًا لوكالة الأنباء السعودية

الواجهات:

تحتوي الساعة على أربع واجهات، يبلغ قياس الواجهتين الأمامية والخلفية 43 x 43 مترًا، بينما يبلغ قياس الواجهتين الجانبيتين حوالي 43 × 39 مترًا 

الزخرفة:

تزين قمة الساعة عبارة الجلالة «الله أكبر»، حيث يتجاوز طول حرف الألف في كلمة «الله» 23 مترًا، كما يعلوها هلال يبلغ قطره 23 مترا، وفقا لموقع كارديلان

التوقيت:

يرتبط مركز توقيت مكة المكرمة بشبكة التوقيت العالمي UTC

الإضاءة:

تستخدم الساعة حوالي 21,000 مصباح LED باللونين الأخضر والأبيض لإضاءتها أثناء الأذان، ويمكن رؤية هذه الإضاءة من مسافات تصل إلى عدة كيلومترات

#قرآن #قرآن_كريم #explore ي.

حب ح
الشيخ محمد صديق المنشاوي (1920-1969) هو أحد أقطار دولة التلاوة المصرية والعالم الإسلامي، ويُعرف بلقب الصوت الباكي" نظرًا لخشوعه الشديد في القراءة الذي يلمس القلوب

أبرز المحطات في حياته

المعروفين أيضًا.

النشأة ولد في قرية "المنشأة" بمحافظة سوهاج لأسرة قرآنية عريقة فوالده الشيخ صديق المنشاوي وشقيقه محمود المنشاوي كانا من القراء

المسيرة أتم حفظ القرآن في الثامنة من عمره، واعتمدته الإذاعة المصرية قارنا في الخمسينيات بعد أن انتقلت إليه خصيصا لتسجيل تلاوته عقب رفضه الأولي للتقدم للاختبارات.

التراث ترك للمكتبة الإسلامية تسجيلين كاملين للمصحف مرتل ومجود، بالإضافة إلى تلاوات نادرة من المسجد الأقصى الكويت

سوريا وليبيا.

الوفاة توفي في 20 يونيو 1969 عن عمر ناهز 49 عاما بعد صراع مع مرض دوالي المريء"، وظل يقرأ القرآن حتى أيامه الأخيرة.

أجمع العلماء والمشايخ على مكانة الشيخ محمد صديق المنشاوي الاستثنائية، ووصفوه بصفات تعكس خشوعه وإتقانه، ومن أبرز ما 
 
قالوه

الشيخ عبد العزيز بن باز وصف صوته بأنه "الصوت الذي لا يمل سماعة ".

الشيخ محمد متولي الشعراوي قال عنه : "من أراد أن يستمتع إلى خشوع القرآن فليستمع لصوت المنشاوي"، ووصفه بأنه ورفاقه يركبون مركب الإبحار في بحار القرآن الكريم

الشيخ محمد ناصر الدين الألباني نقل عنه أنه كان رقيق القلب سريع الدمعة، وكان يحب الاستماع لتلاوة المنشاوي والإنصات له

snippet.title: Los Santos is More Than Just a City❤️
snippet.description:
Why are we getting emotional over a fictional city? Because Los Santos was never just a collection of buildings, roads and locations on a map. For more than 13 years, GTA 5 turned this fictional version of Los Angeles into a place where millions of players created their own memories. From the Vinewood Hills and downtown Los Santos to the beaches, highways, Sandy Shores and the countryside of Blaine County, almost every corner of the map has a story attached to it.

Grand Theft Auto V released in 2013 and somehow became a part of an entire generation of gaming. We spent countless hours driving through Los Santos, causing chaos with Michael, Franklin and Trevor, exploring the city, completing missions, discovering random events, listening to the radio and eventually creating completely different memories in GTA Online. We watched GTA Online grow through years of updates, met friends in Los Santos, bought our first apartments and businesses, collected cars, pulled off heists and simply drove around the city with nothing planned. That is what made Los Santos feel so much more real than just another video game map.

Now, as GTA 6 prepares to take us from Los Santos to Vice City and the wider state of Leonida, it feels like the end of an era. GTA 5 will always be the game that defined more than a decade of memories for so many players, and Los Santos will always be the fictional city we somehow became attached to. On November 19, 2026, a new chapter begins with GTA VI, but no matter how incredible Vice City becomes, a part of us will always remember the city where it all happened. Goodbye, Los Santos. Thanks for 13 unforgettable years.

snippet.title: I Found the Biggest GTA 5 Videos Ever. It's NOT What You Think
snippet.description:
The most-watched GTA 5 video I could find on YouTube has more views than the GTA 6 trailer, and it doesn't even say GTA in the title. I pulled 5,000 of the biggest GTA 5 videos with YouTube's own data to find out who really ruled GTA 5 on YouTube, year by year, and where all those YouTubers went before GTA 6.

📊 In this video: how I counted (90 YouTube searches, 5,016 GTA 5 videos, dates and views from the YouTube Data API on 31 Oct 2026), why the biggest year for GTA 5 videos was 2020 and not 2013, the king of every year (Fernanfloo, VanossGaming, Jelly, the Spider-Man ragdoll channels, MrBeast Gaming's one summer, Techno Gamerz), why GTA RP barely exists on YouTube, DarkViperAU's 96-kill pacifist run, the Indian channels that have owned GTA 5 since 2020, a 20-second clip with 294 million views, and where each of them is now.

💬 Who was YOUR GTA 5 YouTuber? Tell me in the comments.

snippet.title: One day, we’ll explore Los Santos for the last time #gta #gaming #gta5 #gtaonline #ps5 #gta6 #gamer
snippet.description:
One day, we’ll explore Los Santos for the last time… without even knowing it. 🥹💔

2013. The year it all began.

A city that felt endless. Three characters who became legends. Countless missions, unforgettable memories, and a world we never wanted to leave. 🌴❤️

We grew up driving through these streets, watching sunsets over Los Santos, escaping five-star police chases, and spending countless hours doing absolutely nothing… yet somehow enjoying every second of it.

Back then, GTA V was just another game we were excited to play.

13 years later, it became a part of our childhood, our teenage years, and our lives. 🥀

And now, as we prepare for GTA VI, something feels different.

We’re excited for Vice City, new adventures, new characters, and a whole new world to explore.

But deep down, we know…

Nothing will ever replace the feeling of playing GTA V for the very first time. ❤️‍🩹

The streets will always be there. The memories will never fade.

This isn’t the end of GTA V. It’s the end of an era that defined a generation of gamers.

Thank you for everything, Los Santos. 🌅

GOODBYE, OLD FRIEND. 💔

snippet.title: THE END OF AN ERA... MY GTA 5 MEMORIES
snippet.description:
After years of unforgettable moments, incredible memories and countless hours exploring Los Santos, it's time to look back at the journey that was GTA 5 and GTA Online. ❤️

From the early days of GTA Online to the biggest updates, heists, crazy adventures and everything in between, this game has given us so much over the years.

For DeadManDownunder, GTA 5 and GTA Online have been the foundation of this channel. There have been some incredible moments along the way, and I wanted to take one last drive through Los Santos, reflect on the memories and say thank you before we move into a new chapter.

With GTA 6 on the horizon, the end of one era means the beginning of another.

Thank you to everyone who has watched, supported and been part of the DMDU journey. Whether you've been here from the beginning or only recently joined, I appreciate every one of you.

Here's to the memories, the madness and one hell of a ride.

Thank you, GTA 5. It's been a blast.

snippet.title: Lufthansa A340-600 tribute edit - saying goodbye to a legend 🫡🕊️| #aviation #lufthansa #a340 #edit
snippet.description: This edit has taken me a total of 1.5 hours to make and it would be nice to get views but I don’t really care as much. I nearly had the privilege of flying this beauty last September while they still flew to HKG. I was going to fly HKG-FRA-LHR but the flights came out too expensive to justify it and then we took BA instead (flight review on channel). Less than a month later, Lufthansa retired the A340-600 from HKG, and now a year later, they are retiring it forever. I’m so disappointed I never got to fly on the Lufthansa A340-600, though as a kid I always used to fly the Virgin Atlantic A340-600 to LHR, but never really appreciated. May one of the flying pencils rest in peace 🫡🕊️
